name: Mahjong Cafe

address: Golden Grove Kitchen, 12035 Collier Blvd, Naples, FL 34116
schedule: Tuesdays 9AM-12PM beginner instruction + breakfast; 1PM-4PM lunch & social play; evening play 6-9PM starting October (Mondays/Tuesdays); tickets via Ticket Tailor

name: Naples Ladies Mah Jongg (American Version)

schedule: Tuesday and Thursday evenings (in season); reserve spot via Meetup

name: Naples Mahjong

schedule: Events at various Naples venues; lessons up to $60 per Gulfshore Life
